notes: The Hebrew writes a connective for each member (וְרָגַז / וְשָׂחַק), so rule 14's correlative-pair sentence does not apply: each waw takes only the word written for it, *Whether* and *or*.
The third waw is `unrepresented` because the ASV opens *there will be no rest* with no connective; the supplied *If* answers to no conjunction in the protasis (rule 55).
The margin's *He rageth and laugheth, and there is no rest* was read and set aside under rule 38.
